decision: The original NetAPI public/internal/com/inc/rpcutil.h suffices for isolated compilation, as do SDK rpc.h plus rpcndr.h. The production VDMREDIR link still fails LNK2019 for _MIDL_user_allocate@4 and _MIDL_user_free@4, also with /Gy and explicit /OPT:REF /INCREMENTAL:NO. The adjacent allocstr build rule does not resolve this edge. Original netlib/midluser.c defines the allocator ownership separately. No new allocator, import or shim introduced for this unused enumeration API.

verification.compiler: Pinned header and SDK pair both pass x86 compile with /we4013; without prototypes C4013.
verification.link: Three restoration trials failed LNK1120. Actual VDMREDIR.dll relink passed after restoring the audited subset.
tests: PASS original packstr: exact fit, overflow/no-write, NULL terminator, no-room
